lines.en: Good morning everyone. Let's keep it quick — what did you do yesterday, what's today, any blockers? Alex, you're first.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。咱们简短一点——昨天做了什么、今天做什么、有没有阻塞？Alex，你先来。

lines.en: Yesterday I finished the API endpoint for user profile updates. Today I'm starting on the notification service. No blockers.
lines.zh: 昨天我完成了用户资料更新的 API 接口。今天开始做通知服务。没有阻塞。

lines.en: Great. Maria?
lines.zh: 好。Maria？

lines.en: I was working on the dashboard filters. Today I'll continue — but I'm blocked. The API spec for the filter endpoint still hasn't been updated. I can't finish without it.
lines.zh: 我一直在做看板的筛选功能。今天继续——但我被卡住了。筛选接口的 API 规格还没更新，没有它我做不完。

lines.en: Noted. Alex, can you update the spec by noon?
lines.zh: 记下了。Alex，你能在中午前更新那份规格吗？

lines.en: Sure, I'll add that to my morning.
lines.zh: 没问题，我上午就加上。

lines.en: Thanks. Sam?
lines.zh: 谢谢。Sam？

lines.en: Yesterday I wrote test cases for the login flow. Today I'll run regression on the profile update. No blockers.
lines.zh: 昨天我写了登录流程的测试用例。今天对资料更新跑回归测试。没有阻塞。

title: 02 印度团队远程站会
file: 02-印度团队站会/02-印度团队站会.mp3

lines.en: Remote standup via video call. Three participants.
lines.zh: 远程视频站会，三位参与者。

lines.en: OK, sprint day 7. Raj, you were working on the auth refactor?
lines.zh: 好，迭代第 7 天。Raj，你之前在做认证重构？

lines.en: Yeah, pushed the changes yesterday. PR is up for review — it's a big one, about 400 lines. I'd actually appreciate a second reviewer if anyone has bandwidth.
lines.zh: 对，昨天已经把改动推上去了。PR 已经提出来等评审——挺大的，大概 400 行。如果有人有精力，我挺想再要一个评审人。

lines.en: I can take a look this afternoon. James, how about the mobile push notifications?
lines.zh: 我下午可以看一下。James，移动端推送通知怎么样了？

lines.en: Still in progress. I hit an issue with Firebase on Android 12 — the payload structure changed. I need another day to work around it. So my estimate was Wednesday, but I'm pushing it to Thursday.
lines.zh: 还在做。遇到一个 Android 12 上 Firebase 的问题——推送负载结构变了。我还需要一天绕过它。原估计周三，现在顺延到周四。

lines.en: OK, flag me if you get stuck. Any risks for the Friday release?
lines.zh: 好，卡住了就叫我。周五发版有风险吗？

lines.en: Low. The feature is non-critical and behind a flag.
lines.zh: 风险低。这个功能不是关键路径，而且在开关（feature flag）后面。

lines.en: I'm good if reviews come in today.
lines.zh: 只要今天评审能反馈，我这边就没问题。

title: 03 迭代末站会：演示前抢修

lines.en: Sprint review standup. Team of five.
lines.zh: 迭代评审前的站会，五人团队。

lines.en: We're on the last day of the sprint. Let's do a quick status round before the review meeting. Carla?
lines.zh: 今天是迭代最后一天。趁评审会之前快速过一轮状态。Carla？

lines.en: I finished the data export feature and it's in staging. Tested and passing. Ready for review.
lines.zh: 我完成了数据导出功能，已经在预发布环境。测过全部通过。可以评审了。

lines.en: Good. Dan?
lines.zh: 好。Dan？

lines.en: I'm done with the settings page UI. But I found a visual regression in the notification bell — it's a quick CSS fix, thirty minutes top. I'll push it before we demo.
lines.zh: 设置页 UI 我做完了。但发现通知铃铛有个视觉回归（样式退化）——一个小 CSS 修复，最多 30 分钟。演示前我会推上去。

lines.en: Can you commit to that? The demo starts at two.
lines.zh: 你能承诺做到吗？演示两点开始。

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll have it done by one thirty.
lines.zh: 当然。一点半之前搞定。

lines.en: Great. Nina?
lines.zh: 很好。Nina？

lines.en: I completed test coverage for Carla's feature — forty-seven test cases, all passing. I also found a low-priority bug in the user settings form — filed it as a backlog item, not a blocker.
lines.zh: 我完成了 Carla 那个功能的测试覆盖——47 个用例全部通过。另外在用户设置表单里发现一个低优先级缺陷——已作为待办项登记，不算阻塞。

lines.en: Perfect. Sprint's looking good for closure.
lines.zh: 完美。这个迭代收尾看起来没问题。

title: 04 速率复盘 + 事故跟进

lines.en: End of sprint standup. Focus on velocity.
lines.zh: 迭代末站会，重点谈速率。

lines.en: Last item before we wrap — velocity. We committed to thirty-four points this sprint. Ben, what did we actually deliver?
lines.zh: 收尾前最后一项——速率。这个迭代我们承诺了 34 个点。Ben，实际交付了多少？

lines.en: We shipped twenty-eight. Six points slipped: the email digest feature moved to next sprint — the third-party integration took longer than estimated.
lines.zh: 交付了 28 个。有 6 个点滑了：邮件摘要功能推到下个迭代——第三方集成比估算的耗时更长。

lines.en: So about eighty-two percent velocity. Not bad, but the email digest pushed twice now. We should probably spike on the integration in the planning session.
lines.zh: 那大约 82% 的速率。不算差，但邮件摘要已经推了两次。我们该在计划会上针对这个集成做一次技术探针（spike）。

lines.en: Agreed. I'll add a tech spike to the backlog for that. One hour scoped.
lines.zh: 同意。我把它作为技术探针加进待办列表，限定一小时。

lines.en: Good. Also — we had one incident this sprint. Sam?
lines.zh: 好。另外——这个迭代出了一次事故。Sam？

lines.en: Yeah, a twelve-minute outage Tuesday caused by a config deployment without rollback. I'm adding a rollback verification step to our deploy checklist. It's a process fix, not a code fix.
lines.zh: 对，周二一次 12 分钟的中断，起因是一次没有回滚方案的配置发布。我正在给部署清单加一步回滚验证。这是流程修复，不是代码修复。

lines.en: Thanks Sam. OK — retrospective in ten minutes. See you there.
lines.zh: 谢谢 Sam。好——10 分钟后开回顾会，到时候见。

lines.en: Distributed team standup across three time zones. London, Warsaw, Singapore.
lines.zh: 跨三个时区的分布式团队站会：伦敦、华沙、新加坡。

lines.en: Quick reminder — async standups via Slack are fine for non-critical days, but let's do a sync call on Mondays. Today's Tuesday, so this is async — I'll just read out the updates.
lines.zh: 快速提醒——非关键的日子用 Slack 异步站会就行，但周一我们还是开一次同步电话会。今天周二，所以是异步——我把大家的更新读一遍。

lines.en: From Jamie in Singapore: completed the data pipeline refactor, starting on the caching layer. No blockers, but he wants eyes on his schema design — will post in dev-review.
lines.zh: 新加坡的 Jamie：数据管道重构已完成，开始做缓存层。没有阻塞，但他希望有人看看他的 schema 设计——会发到 dev-review 频道。

lines.en: From Marta in Warsaw: PR two twenty-three is ready for review. She'll be out of office Thursday afternoon, back Friday.
lines.zh: 华沙的 Marta：PR #223 已就绪待评审。她周四下午不在（OOO），周五回来。

lines.en: From myself: in product meetings all morning, available from one PM London. Our retrospective is Thursday at four PM London, five PM Warsaw, eleven PM Singapore. I'll record it for Jamie.
lines.zh: 我自己：一上午都在产品会，伦敦时间下午 1 点起有空。回顾会在伦敦时间周四 16:00、华沙 17:00、新加坡 23:00。我会录下来发给 Jamie。
